item.description:
**Company Description**
At SAP, you will be part of a global environment that values shared learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will work across international teams, exchange knowledge openly, and develop alongside colleagues committed to advancing machine learning engineering practices. SAP's culture encourages curiosity, inclusion, and growth, giving you opportunities to contribute meaningfully no matter your level.
**Job Description**
**What you'll bring** You have hands-on experience building and operating ML systems in production, with solid skills in Python, data pipelines, and ranking or retrieval systems.
* Python proficiency and hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines at scale. Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent. * Solid knowledge of ranking, retrieval, or recommendation systems; experience with multi-signal fusion or semantic search is a plus. * SQL fluency and comfort working with large-scale columnar data stores. * End-to-end ML ownership across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring; experience with A/B experimentation is a plus. * Degree not required for this role.
We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates to be comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI. Candidates should be able to create effective inputs. They must automate routine tasks and evaluate the quality of AI-generated outputs. Additionally, they should promote the adoption of AI practices within their teams.
**What you'll build** You will build and maintain ML systems that power personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees, covering offline pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops.
* Build and maintain offline ML pipelines for signal extraction, feature engineering, and candidate generation. * Contribute to request-time ranking logic that fuses signals from multiple ML routes into a personalized result. * Extract and transform employee signals; skills, proficiency, and learning history, into reusable, scenario-agnostic feature snapshots. * Design and maintain quality gates that validate ML pipeline outputs before they reach the serving layer. * Build the experimentation infrastructure. This includes A/B schemas, offline evaluation, and ablation testing. These tools will help measure improvements accurately and thoroughly. * Collaborate with Data Scientists, Architects, and Product to refine algorithms and ship end-to-end ML systems.
**Where you belong** You will join a small, high-ownership pod building personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees at scale. The team runs offline ML pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops in production, processing signals from millions of employees. You will work directly alongside Data Scientists, Architects, and Product from day one, shipping end-to-end ML systems.
**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Agentic Automated Reasoning Group is building the next generation of software verification tools combining advances in artificial intelligence, the computational capacity of the cloud, and our deep expertise in the domain. Join us if you want to be a part of this transformational endeavor.
The Strata team (https://github.com/strata-org) is seeking a Sr. Applied Scientist with broad interest and expertise in interactive theorem proving, programming language semantics, deductive verification and generative AI. You will combine your expertise with that of your coworkers to build new tools that solve code analysis problems previously considered beyond reach. Our application areas span all the way from Infrastructure as Code to high-performance cryptography written in assembly code.
Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers make billions of transactions worldwide on AWS. They harness the power of the cloud to enable innovative applications, websites, and businesses. Using automated reasoning technology and mathematical proofs, AWS allows customers to answer questions about security, availability, durability, and functional correctness. We call this provable security, absolute assurance in security of the cloud and in the cloud. https://aws.amazon.com/security/provable-security/
Key job responsibilities
* Delivering practical and scalable AR solutions working backwards customer use cases * Identify tools and methods capable of addressing the verification needs of customers, including any novel analysis capabilities required. * Use tools spanning from fuzzers, property-based testing to model checkers, and interactive theorem provers to establish program properties. * Explore generative AI techniques to help customers formalize their requirements, find revealing tests, generate required boiler plate for testing and model checking, and find and repair program proofs.
About the team You will be working with a team of formal verification specialists spanning recently hired PhDs to industry veterans. You will work collaboratively to deliver results in the form of verified code and tools to accelerate code verification for our customer teams.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. * Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build.
We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap.
Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era.
**How we build** ----------------
At Mavria, three principles guide how we work:
* **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain. * **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor. * **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. **Role scope** ==============

You’ll work side by side with those teams to learn how they design and build Terrain, then build the internal tools that make them faster. You’ll own each tool end to end, from the data pipelines underneath to the apps our engineers use every day, with one goal: 10x the productivity of the teams you support. You will:
